name: LeafScan Hierarchical Solanaceous Diagnosis Bundle
description: Production ONNX models with CBAM attention and two-tier safety gating for Potato and Tomato pathology.
disclaimer: This deep learning model provides automated screening assistance for educational and decision-support purposes only. It does not replace professional on-site plant pathology diagnosis. Always consult certified agricultural extension officers and strictly follow locally registered pesticide label instructions prior to chemical applications.

advisories.species_uncertain: SPECIES UNCERTAINTY: Automated botanist confidence is below the safety threshold (<90%). Specimen disease diagnosis has been abstained to avoid crop misdiagnosis. Provide a clear, well-lit photograph showing leaf margins and venation, or submit a sample to an accredited agricultural extension laboratory. Do NOT apply chemical treatments to unverified plant species.
advisories.late_blight_uncertain: LATE BLIGHT UNCERTAINTY: Folio symptoms indicate potential early lesions, but diagnostic confidence is below the high-consequence threshold (<90%). Lesions may indicate mechanical injury, environmental necrosis, or early Alternaria spots. DO NOT apply aggressive systemic fungicides at this stage. Isolate specimen, monitor closely, and re-inspect within 24 to 48 hours. Consult a certified agronomic consultant if symptoms expand.
advisories.late_blight_confirmed: LATE BLIGHT DETECTED: Symptoms are characteristic of Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) with high diagnostic confidence. Under humid conditions, late blight can cause rapid defoliation. Recommended management options: remove and safely bag severely infected foliage; avoid overhead irrigation. Review registered protective or systemic fungicides with your local extension agent and follow label rates strictly.
advisories.early_blight_confirmed: EARLY BLIGHT DETECTED: Symptoms are characteristic of Early Blight (Alternaria solani) with high diagnostic confidence. Recommended management options: prune lower senescent leaves to minimize soil-splash inoculation; ensure proper plant spacing for canopy drying. If chemical control is warranted, consult certified agricultural extension guidelines for locally approved preventive fungicides.
advisories.healthy_confirmed: NO FOLIAR BLIGHT DETECTED: The specimen displays healthy foliar tissue without apparent Early Blight or Late Blight lesions. Note: This assessment evaluates foliar blight symptoms visible in the photograph and does not guarantee absence of latent, viral, or soil-borne pathogens. Maintain standard sanitation, drip irrigation, and regular field scouting.
advisories.general_disease_uncertain: MARGINAL DIAGNOSTIC CONFIDENCE: Classification confidence is below 70%. Visual symptoms are ambiguous. Re-photograph the leaf in diffuse daylight and monitor for further lesion development before initiating any management actions.
advisories.out_of_scope: OUT OF SCOPE SPECIMEN: The input leaf could not be reliably verified as Potato (Solanum tuberosum) or Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum), or the image is out-of-distribution. Consult a local agricultural extension officer or certified agronomist for non-Solanaceous pathology.
